definitions.explanation: Describes achievements, careers, or events that are impressively successful and attract admiration. Implies public visibility and remarkable accomplishment.

examples.japanese: {華々|はなばな}しい⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{華々|はなばな}しい⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: He has a brilliant career history.

examples.japanese: {華々|はなばな}しい⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地道|じみち}→地道：15599_jimichi⟧な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Behind the spectacular achievements was steady, quiet effort.

notes:
{華々|はなばな}しい is an i-adjective meaning splendid or spectacular. Written with the repeated kanji {華|はな}, emphasizing brilliance and splendor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {華々|はなばな}しい⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧: spectacular debut
- {華々|はなばな}しい⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: brilliant performance/achievement
- {華々|はなばな}しい⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧: impressive career
- {華々|はなばな}しい⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧: splendid results

FORMS:
- Adverb: {華々|はなばな}しく
- {華々|はなばな}しく⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧: to fall/die gloriously
- {華々|はなばな}しく⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to adorn splendidly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {華々|はなばな}しい: splendid, spectacular (public, attention-getting)
- ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧: plain, unassuming (quiet, behind-the-scenes)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {華々|はなばな}しくなかったら
